{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
exit $code

#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"

ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)

  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"

head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. nyc-instrument the repo copy
#   2. run the node harness (coverage vehicle) over run_all.json's files
#   3. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"
# non-js payloads (configs, instructions, fixtures)
(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude='*.js' --exclude='.git' --exclude='.dart_tool' .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
head -40 "$WORK/crap.txt"
sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -30
grep -E "preparePRForReview" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)

#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]

REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"

  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

content.text:
steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)

#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]

REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools

rm -rf "$WORK"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"

  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.

        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:

WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"

INST="$WORK/inst"

rm -rf "$WORK"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
