#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on

#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)

# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]

FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"

  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \

code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |

            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"

FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \

  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)

REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"

  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"

grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40

# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL

# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"

rm -rf "$WORK"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"

  "$COV" $FILES \

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"

            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: Fetch the released baseline

        env:

        run: |

               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)

#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]

REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools

rm -rf "$WORK"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"

  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.

        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

- Split `js/preparePRForReview.js::action` (CRAP 1792.9, CC 65, 25.8% stmt coverage — the repo's worst hotspot) into a short orchestrator (CC 5) plus 29 exported single-purpose helpers: parse context/PR anchor, resolve repository, find PR, fetch details/diff/discussions, checkout, detect failed checks, build/post comments, finish. - Added `js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview.js` — 28 characterization tests on `action` (happy/failure/degraded paths, `pr-N` + `jobParams.prNumber`/`pr` anchors, call-order pins) plus direct tests of the extracted helpers; registered in `run_all.json` and new `run_preparePRForReview.json`.

### Key decisions
- Steps return `{failed, comment}` descriptors so `action` stays linear and the CRAP ratchet (threshold 8) passes with real margin.
- Fixed a latent crash: the `catch` block referenced block-scoped `noTicket` (ReferenceError) for any early throw — the context is now seeded before `try`, so errors log and return `false` as designed; a config-load failure posts no comment (no tracker exists yet), while mid-flow failures post the setup-error comment.
- Coverage/CRAP verified locally against the released `crap-baseline` release asset with the pinned crap4js build: `action` CRAP 1792.9 → 5; ratchet shows 0 regressions, 0 new over threshold.

```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_preparePRForReview.json   # 28 tests

# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)

# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]

FILTER="${3:-}"

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"

  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.

        # global after the run.

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]

REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)

"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

steps:

        run: |

            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: Fetch the released baseline

        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"### What changed
- Split `js/preparePRForReview.js::action` (CRAP 1792.9, CC 65, 25.8% stmt coverage — the repo's worst hotspot) into a short orchestrator (CC 5) plus 29 exported single-purpose helpers: parse context/PR anchor, resolve repository, find PR, fetch details/diff/discussions, checkout, detect failed checks, build/post comments, finish. Log lines, call order and return shapes are preserved.
- Added `js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview.js` — 28 characterization tests on `action` (happy/failure/degraded paths, `pr-N` + `jobParams.prNumber`/`pr` anchors, call-order pins) plus direct tests of the extracted helpers; registered in `run_all.json` and new `run_preparePRForReview.json`.

### Key decisions
- Steps return `{failed, comment}` descriptors so `action` stays linear and the CRAP ratchet (threshold 8) passes with real margin.
- Fixed a latent crash: the `catch` block referenced block-scoped `noTicket` (ReferenceError) for any early throw — the context is now seeded before `try`, so errors log and return `false` as designed; a config-load failure posts no comment (no tracker exists yet), while mid-flow failures post the setup-error comment.
- Coverage/CRAP verified locally against the released `crap-baseline` release asset with the pinned crap4js build: `action` CRAP 1792.9 → 5; ratchet shows 0 regressions, 0 new over threshold.
- Note for maintainers: on GitHub-hosted runners the quality-gate coverage keys (repo paths) fall outside the `$RUNNER_TEMP/inst` walk root, so the ratchet currently passes vacuously (all N/A); local verification above used the repo as the crap4js root to get real numbers.

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_preparePRForReview.json   # 28 tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                  # 2982 passed, 0 failed
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  P[params] --> PC[parseContext / parsePrAnchor]
  PC --> LC[loadContext]
  LC --> LOG[logPreparationStart]
  LOG --> RR[resolveRepoInfo]
  RR --> FP[findPullRequest]
  FP --> FD[fetchPrDetails]
  FD --> CO[checkoutPrBranch]
  CO --> GD[generateDiff + fetchDiscussionData]
  GD --> WC[writePrContext]
  WC --> DC[detectCheckFailures]
  DC --> FR[finishReviewStart]
  FR --> BS[buildSuccessResult]
  RR & FP & FD -.->|failed| PFC[postFailureComment]
  AC[action orchestrator] --> PC

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Mirrors .github/workflows/quality.yml locally:
#   1. copy the repo to $INST (like CI's cp -r to $RUNNER_TEMP/inst)
#   2. nyc-instrument the copy IN PLACE (coverage keys then live under $INST)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$INST"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code
","path":"/tmp/run_crap.sh"}

{"content":"#!/bin/bash
# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL
# coverage attribution: CI runs crap4js from $INST (where the coverage keys —
# repo paths — land outside the root and the gate passes vacuously on
# GitHub-hosted runners); here crap4js runs from the repo cwd so the keys
# match directly and the ratchet is evaluated with real numbers.
#   1. copy the repo to $INST
#   2. nyc instrument repo -> $INST (coverage keys = repo-absolute paths)
#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"
node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
  --coverage "$COV" \
  --threshold 8 \
  --baseline "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json" > "$WORK/crap.txt"
code=$?
grep -E "Ratchet|regression|improvement" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -5
grep -E " js/preparePRForReview\.js| js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview\.js" "$WORK/crap.txt" | head -40
exit $code

/home/runner/work/dmtools-agents/dmtools-agents
### What changed
- Split `js/preparePRForReview.js::action` (CRAP 1792.9, CC 65, 25.8% stmt coverage — the repo's worst hotspot) into a short orchestrator (CC 5) plus 29 exported single-purpose helpers: parse context/PR anchor, resolve repository, find PR, fetch details/diff/discussions, checkout, detect failed checks, build/post comments, finish. Log lines, call order and return shapes are preserved.
- Added `js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview.js` — 28 characterization tests on `action` (happy/failure/degraded paths, `pr-N` + `jobParams.prNumber`/`pr` anchors, call-order pins) plus direct tests of the extracted helpers; registered in `run_all.json` and new `run_preparePRForReview.json`.

### Key decisions
- Steps return `{failed, comment}` descriptors so `action` stays linear and the CRAP ratchet (threshold 8) passes with real margin.
- Fixed a latent crash: the `catch` block referenced block-scoped `noTicket` (ReferenceError) for any early throw — the context is now seeded before `try`, so errors log and return `false` as designed; a config-load failure posts no comment (no tracker exists yet), while mid-flow failures post the setup-error comment.
- CRAP verified locally against the released `crap-baseline` asset with the pinned crap4js build: `action` 1792.9 → 5.0 at 100% coverage; every function in both changed files scores ≤ 8 (max: `parsePrAnchor` 7). The only flags in a full-tree real-coverage run are pre-existing artifacts outside this diff — `ci/*.cjs` have zero baseline entries and `githubSource.js::matchesGuards` moves 90.4 → 93.5 from measurement variance (file untouched by this PR).
- Note for maintainers: on GitHub-hosted runners the quality gate's coverage keys (repo paths) fall outside the `$RUNNER_TEMP/inst` walk root, so the ratchet currently passes vacuously (all N/A); the numbers above come from running crap4js with the repo as its root so attribution is real.

### How to verify
```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_preparePRForReview.json   # 28 tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                  # 2982 passed, 0 failed
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  P[params] --> PC[parseContext / parsePrAnchor]
  PC --> LC[loadContext]
  LC --> LOG[logPreparationStart]
  LOG --> RR[resolveRepoInfo]
  RR --> FP[findPullRequest]
  FP --> FD[fetchPrDetails]
  FD --> CO[checkoutPrBranch]
  CO --> GD[generateDiff + fetchDiscussionData]
  GD --> WC[writePrContext]
  WC --> DC[detectCheckFailures]
  DC --> FR[finishReviewStart]
  FR --> BS[buildSuccessResult]
  RR & FP & FD -.->|failed| PFC[postFailureComment]
  AC[action orchestrator] --> PC
```

</details>

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # The harness expects the consumer layout (agents/ checkout beside
          # the cwd) and bare config names — self-symlink covers both.
          ln -sfn "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/agents"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # The node harness is a degraded mirror of the dmtools runner
        # (~108 known mock-gap failures, e.g. cli_execute_command stubs);
        # the canonical green-gate is the pack-release test job. Coverage is
        # collected regardless — a red harness must not block the ratchet.
        # ci/run_with_coverage.js wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul
        # global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES \
            || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# Local mirror of .github/workflows/quality.yml with one deviation for REAL

#   3. symlink $INST/agents -> $INST (harness agents/-prefix fallback)
#   4. run the node harness over run_all.json's files (coverage vehicle)
#   5. crap4js ratchet vs the released crap-baseline, projectRoot = repo
# Usage: run_crap.sh <repo-dir> <work-dir> [testFilter]
set -u
REPO="$(cd "$1" && pwd)"
WORK="$2"
FILTER="${3:-}"
TOOLS=/tmp/tools
INST="$WORK/inst"
COV="$WORK/cov/coverage-final.json"

rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/cov" "$WORK/base" "$INST"
cp /tmp/crap-baseline.json "$WORK/base/crap-baseline.json"

(cd "$REPO" && tar cf - --exclude=.git --exclude=.dart_tool --exclude=.fah .) | (cd "$INST" && tar xf -)
cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd "$REPO" "$REPO" "$INST" > /dev/null 2>&1
ln -sfn "$INST" "$INST/agents"

cd "$INST"
FILES="$(node -e "var f=require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles; console.log(f.filter(function(x){return '$FILTER'===''||x.indexOf('$FILTER')!==-1}).join(' '))")"

  "$INST/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
  "$COV" $FILES \
  || echo "::warning::node harness has known mock gaps — coverage still collected"

cd "$REPO"
"$TOOLS/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \

### What changed
- Split `js/preparePRForReview.js::action` (CRAP 1792.9, CC 65, 25.8% stmt coverage — the repo's worst hotspot) into a short orchestrator (CC 5) plus 29 exported single-purpose helpers: parse context/PR anchor, resolve repository, find PR, fetch details/diff/discussions, checkout, detect failed checks, build/post comments, finish. Log lines, call order and return shapes are preserved.
- Added `js/unit-tests/test_preparePRForReview.js` — 28 characterization tests on `action` (happy/failure/degraded paths, `pr-N` + `jobParams.prNumber`/`pr` anchors, call-order pins) plus direct tests of the extracted helpers; registered in `run_all.json` and new `run_preparePRForReview.json`.

### Key decisions
- Steps return `{failed, comment}` descriptors so `action` stays linear and the CRAP ratchet (threshold 8) passes with real margin.
- Fixed a latent crash: the `catch` block referenced block-scoped `noTicket` (ReferenceError) for any early throw — the context is now seeded before `try`, so errors log and return `false` as designed; a config-load failure posts no comment (no tracker exists yet), while mid-flow failures post the setup-error comment.
- CRAP verified locally against the released `crap-baseline` asset with the pinned crap4js build: `action` 1792.9 → 5.0 at 100% coverage; every function in both changed files scores ≤ 8 (max: `parsePrAnchor` 7). The only flags in a full-tree real-coverage run are pre-existing artifacts outside this diff — `ci/*.cjs` have zero baseline entries and `githubSource.js::matchesGuards` moves 90.4 → 93.5 from measurement variance (file untouched by this PR).
- Note for maintainers: on GitHub-hosted runners the quality gate's coverage keys (repo paths) fall outside the `$RUNNER_TEMP/inst` walk root, so the ratchet currently passes vacuously (all N/A); the numbers above come from running crap4js with the repo as its root so attribution is real.

```bash
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_preparePRForReview.json   # 28 tests
dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json                  # 2982 passed, 0 failed
```

```
